I think I'm sick with a cold.
note: 'Catch a cold' = bị cảm.

vi: Mình muốn đặt lịch khám với bác sĩ.
en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor.
alt: I'd like to book an appointment with the doctor.
I want to make an appointment with a doctor.
I'd like to schedule an appointment with the doctor.

vi: Bạn nên uống thuốc sau khi ăn.
en: You should take the medicine after eating.
alt: You should take the medicine after meals.
You should take this medicine after you eat.
You should take the medication after eating.

vi: Mình đang nấu cơm tối.
en: I'm cooking dinner.
alt: I'm making dinner.
I'm preparing dinner.
I'm cooking supper.

vi: Bạn nhớ tắt đèn trước khi ra ngoài nhé.
en: Remember to turn off the lights before you go out.
alt: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave.
Remember to switch off the lights before you leave.
Please turn off the lights before you go out.
note: 'Remember to + V' = nhớ làm gì (việc sắp làm).

vi: Mình quên mang chìa khóa nên bị khóa ngoài nhà.
en: I forgot my keys, so I got locked out.
alt: I forgot my keys and got locked out.
I forgot to bring my keys, so I'm locked out of the house.
I forgot my key, so I locked myself out.
note: 'Locked out' = bị khóa ngoài.

vi: Điện thoại của mình sắp hết pin rồi.
en: My phone is about to die.
alt: My phone is almost out of battery.
My phone battery is almost dead.
My phone is running out of battery.
My phone's battery is about to run out.
note: 'About to die' là cách nói tự nhiên về pin sắp hết.

vi: Bạn có sạc điện thoại cho mình mượn được không?
en: Could I borrow your phone charger?
alt: Can I borrow your charger?
Do you have a charger I could borrow?
Could I borrow your charger, please?
Can I borrow your phone charger?

vi: Mình đang cố giảm cân.
en: I'm trying to lose weight.
alt: I'm trying to lose some weight.
I'm on a diet.
I'm trying to slim down.

vi: Cuối tuần mình thường đi dạo công viên.
en: I usually go for a walk in the park on weekends.
alt: On weekends I usually walk in the park.
I usually take a walk in the park on the weekend.
I usually go walking in the park on weekends.

vi: Mình bị kẹt trong thang máy, bạn gọi giúp mình nhé.
en: I'm stuck in the elevator. Could you call for help?
alt: I'm trapped in the elevator. Please call for help.
I'm stuck in the lift. Could you call someone for help?
I'm stuck in the elevator, can you get help?

vi: Mình cần giặt đồ vào cuối tuần.
en: I need to do laundry this weekend.
alt: I need to do the laundry on the weekend.
I have to do laundry this weekend.
I need to wash my clothes this weekend.
note: 'Do laundry' = giặt đồ.

vi: Mình vừa chuyển đến đây nên chưa quen đường lắm.
en: I just moved here, so I don't know my way around yet.
alt: I just moved here, so I'm not familiar with the area yet.
I've just moved here, so I don't know the area well yet.
I just moved here and I'm still learning my way around.
note: 'Know my way around' = quen đường.

vi: Bạn có thể mở cửa sổ giúp mình không?
en: Could you open the window, please?
alt: Can you open the window, please?
Could you please open the window?
Would you mind opening the window?

vi: Dạo này mình ngủ không ngon nên cảm thấy mệt mỏi cả ngày.
en: I haven't been sleeping well lately, so I feel tired all day.
alt: I haven't been sleeping well recently, so I'm tired all day.
I've been sleeping badly lately, so I feel exhausted all day.
I haven't slept well lately, so I feel tired all day.

vi: Xin lỗi, bạn có thể giúp mình được không?
en: Excuse me, could you help me, please?
alt: Excuse me, can you help me, please?
Excuse me, could you help me?
note: Cách lịch sự để nhờ ai đó giúp đỡ.

vi: Ga tàu ở đâu vậy?
en: Where is the train station?
alt: Where's the train station?

vi: Khách sạn ở đâu vậy?
en: Where is the hotel?
alt: Where's the hotel?

vi: Bảo tàng ở đâu vậy?
en: Where is the museum?
alt: Where's the museum?

vi: Đi thẳng.
en: Go straight.
alt: Go straight ahead.
Keep going straight.

vi: Rẽ trái.
en: Turn left.
alt: Take a left.

vi: Rẽ phải.
en: Turn right.
alt: Take a right.

vi: Đi thẳng rồi rẽ trái.
en: Go straight and turn left.
alt: Go straight, then turn left.
Go straight and then turn left.

vi: Đi thẳng rồi rẽ phải.
en: Go straight and turn right.
alt: Go straight, then turn right.
Go straight and then turn right.

vi: Đi bộ hai dãy nhà.
en: Walk for two blocks.
alt: Walk two blocks.
Go two blocks.
note: 'Block' = một dãy nhà/đoạn phố giữa hai ngã tư.

vi: Đi bộ một dãy nhà.
en: Walk for one block.
alt: Walk one block.
Go one block.

vi: Không có gì đâu.
en: You're welcome.
alt: You are welcome.
No problem.
No worries.

vi: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều.
en: Thank you very much.
alt: Thank you so much.
Thanks a lot.
Thanks so much.

vi: Từ đây đi có xa không?
en: Is it far from here?
alt: Is it a long way from here?

vi: Đi bộ có lâu không?
en: Is it a long walk?
alt: Is it a long way to walk?
Is the walk long?
Does it take long to walk there?

vi: Khách sạn nằm cạnh ngân hàng.
en: The hotel is next to the bank.
alt: The hotel is beside the bank.
It's next to the bank.
note: 'Next to' = 'beside' = ngay cạnh.

vi: Bảo tàng nằm đối diện công viên.
en: The museum is opposite the park.
alt: The museum is across from the park.
It is opposite the park.
note: 'Opposite' (Anh) = 'across from' (Mỹ).

vi: Nhà ga nằm đối diện ngân hàng.
en: The station is across from the bank.
alt: The station is opposite the bank.
The train station is across from the bank.

vi: Bảo tàng nằm gần công viên.
en: The museum is near the park.
alt: The museum is close to the park.
It's near the park.

vi: Nó rất gần.
en: It's very close.
alt: It is very close.
It's really close.
It's very near.

vi: Nó không xa đây đâu.
en: It's not far from here.
alt: It is not far from here.
It's not far.
It isn't far from here.

vi: Mình có bản đồ nhưng hơi bị lạc, mình cần tìm khách sạn.
en: I have a map, but I'm a little lost. I need to find my hotel.
alt: I have a map, but I'm a bit lost. I need to find my hotel.
I've got a map, but I'm a little lost. I need to find my hotel.

vi: Mình đang ở một thành phố mới, mình không biết chỗ này.
en: I'm in a new city. I don't know this place.
alt: I'm in a new city and I don't know this place.
I'm in a new city. I don't know my way around here.

vi: Mình đang tìm khách sạn của mình.
en: I'm looking for my hotel.
alt: I am looking for my hotel.
I'm trying to find my hotel.

vi: Bạn có biết khách sạn này ở đâu không?
en: Do you know where this hotel is?
alt: Do you know where this hotel is located?
note: Sau 'where' dùng trật tự câu khẳng định: 'where this hotel is', không phải 'where is this hotel'.

vi: Có, mình biết. Nó không xa đây đâu.
en: Yes, I know it. It's not far from here.
alt: Yes, I know it. It is not far from here.
Yes, I know it. It isn't far from here.

vi: Bạn không cần đi xe đâu, bạn có thể đi bộ.
en: You don't need to take a car. You can walk.
alt: You don't need a car. You can walk.
You don't need to take a car, you can walk there.
You do not need to take a car. You can walk.

vi: Đi thẳng hai dãy nhà rồi dừng ở đèn giao thông.
en: Go straight for two blocks, then stop at the traffic lights.
alt: Go straight for two blocks and then stop at the traffic lights.
Go straight two blocks, then stop at the traffic light.

vi: Rẽ trái ở đèn giao thông rồi đi bộ một dãy nhà.
en: Turn left at the traffic lights, then walk for one block.
alt: Turn left at the traffic lights and then walk one block.
Turn left at the traffic light, then walk one block.

vi: Mình rẽ trái ở đây phải không?
en: Do I turn left here?
alt: Should I turn left here?
Do I need to turn left here?
Is this where I turn left?

vi: Không, rẽ phải ở đây. Khách sạn ở bên phải bạn.
en: No, turn right here. The hotel is on your right.
alt: No. Turn right here. The hotel is on your right.
No, turn right here. The hotel will be on your right.

vi: Rẽ trái ở con đường tiếp theo.
en: Turn left at the next street.
alt: Take the next left.
Turn left at the next road.
Turn left on the next street.

vi: Bạn có thể chỉ mình đường đến khách sạn không?
en: Could you tell me how to get to the hotel?
alt: Can you tell me how to get to the hotel?
Could you tell me the way to the hotel?
note: 'How to get to...' là cách hỏi đường lịch sự và phổ biến.

vi: Bạn có thể chỉ mình đường đến bảo tàng không?
en: Could you tell me how to get to the museum?
alt: Can you tell me how to get to the museum?
Could you tell me the way to the museum?

vi: Bảo tàng có gần đây không?
en: Is the museum near here?
alt: Is the museum nearby?
Is the museum close to here?
Is the museum around here?

vi: Có, nó ở gần công viên.
en: Yes, it's near the park.
alt: Yes, it is near the park.
Yes, it's close to the park.

vi: Bảo tàng có nằm cạnh công viên không?
en: Is the museum next to the park?
alt: Is the museum beside the park?
Is the museum right next to the park?

vi: Không, chỉ đi bộ năm phút thôi.
en: No, it's only a five-minute walk.
alt: No, it is only a five-minute walk.
No, it's just a five-minute walk.
No, it only takes five minutes to walk.
note: 'a five-minute walk': số đếm + danh từ ghép thì không thêm -s.

vi: Đi thẳng một dãy nhà rồi rẽ phải.
en: Go straight for one block, then turn right.
alt: Go straight for one block and then turn right.
Go straight one block, then turn right.

vi: Rồi sau đó làm gì nữa?
en: Then what?
alt: What do I do next?
And then what?
Then what should I do?

vi: Được rồi, mình hiểu rồi.
en: Okay, I understand.
alt: Okay, got it.
Ok, I understand.
Okay, I get it.
Got it.
note: 'Got it' là cách nói thân mật, rất hay dùng.

vi: Tên khách sạn là gì?
en: What is the name of the hotel?
alt: What's the name of the hotel?
What is the hotel called?
What's the hotel called?

vi: Đó là khách sạn Central.
en: It's the Central Hotel.
alt: It is the Central Hotel.
It's called the Central Hotel.
It's the Central hotel.

vi: Bạn đang tìm gì vậy?
en: What are you looking for?
alt: What are you trying to find?
What do you need?

vi: Mình đã tìm được khách sạn rồi, mình rất vui!
en: I found my hotel! I'm very happy.
alt: I found my hotel. I'm very happy.
I made it to my hotel! I'm very happy.
I found my hotel! I am very happy.

vi: Mình đã đến nơi rồi!
en: I made it!
alt: I'm here!
I got here!
I've arrived!
note: 'I made it' = mình đã đến/đã làm được.

vi: Mình đã đi thẳng, rẽ trái, rồi rẽ phải.
en: I went straight, turned left, and then turned right.
alt: I went straight, then I turned left, and then I turned right.
I went straight, turned left, then turned right.

vi: Bạn tìm thấy nó bằng cách nào vậy?
en: How did you find it?
alt: How did you manage to find it?

vi: Mình đã nhờ người khác giúp.
en: I asked someone for help.
alt: I asked somebody for help.
I asked a person for help.
I asked someone to help me.

vi: Đó là một ý hay.
en: That was a good idea.
alt: That's a good idea.
That was a smart idea.
That was smart.

vi: Sau khi rẽ trái, mình đi bộ một dãy nhà.
en: After I turned left, I walked one block.
alt: After turning left, I walked one block.
After I turned left, I walked for one block.

vi: Bảo tàng có dễ tìm không?
en: Was the museum easy to find?
alt: Was it easy to find the museum?

vi: Có, dễ lắm, vì mình đã hỏi đường.
en: Yes, it was easy because I asked for directions.
alt: Yes, it was easy since I asked for directions.
Yes, it was easy because I asked someone for directions.
note: 'Ask for directions' = hỏi đường.

vi: Hôm nay bạn có bị lạc không? Không, mình không bị lạc.
en: Did you get lost today? No, I didn't.
alt: Did you get lost today? No, I did not.
Did you get lost today? No, I didn't get lost.

vi: Vì sao bạn không bị lạc? Vì mình có bản đồ.
en: Why didn't you get lost? Because I had a map.
alt: Why didn't you get lost? Because I had a map with me.

vi: Lúc đầu thì mình chưa biết đường.
en: I didn't know the way at first.
alt: At first, I didn't know the way.
I did not know the way at first.
At first I didn't know the way.

vi: Cuối cùng mình cũng đến được bảo tàng.
en: I finally reached the museum.
alt: I finally got to the museum.
I finally arrived at the museum.
Finally, I reached the museum.

vi: Mình ở một thành phố mới và không biết đường, nhưng mình vẫn giữ bình tĩnh.
en: I was in a new city and I didn't know the streets, but I stayed calm.
alt: I was in a new city. I didn't know the streets, but I stayed calm.
I was in a new city and didn't know the streets, but I stayed calm.
I was in a new city and I did not know the streets, but I stayed calm.

vi: Hỏi đường thật sự đã giúp mình rất nhiều.
en: Asking for directions really helped me.
alt: Asking for directions really helped me a lot.
Asking for directions helped me a lot.
Asking for directions was really helpful.

vi: Bạn không cần tiếng Anh khó để hỏi đường.
en: You don't need difficult English to ask for directions.
alt: You do not need difficult English to ask for directions.
You don't need hard English to ask for directions.

vi: Tiếng Anh đơn giản là đủ rồi.
en: Simple English is enough.
alt: Simple English is good enough.
Simple English is all you need.
